# Workflow Plan: [Goal]

<!--
Written by /plan-workflow. A roadmap from where the project is to the goal,
built from .claude/docs/workflow-catalog.yaml and what is on disk. Re-run
`/plan-workflow --refresh` to update the Status column; it never changes the goal.

The Status column is an observation from .claude/scripts/artifact-check.sh, not a
verdict. NO_CHECK means completion cannot be detected from files; you tick those
yourself.
-->

**Goal:** [the phase end or step the plan stops at]
**Workflow tier:** [minimal | standard | full]    **Stage:** [project.stage or "not set"]
**Engine:** [engine.name or "not set"]    **Team size:** [team.size]
**Last refreshed:** [YYYY-MM-DD]    **Steps in the catalog read:** [n]    **NO_CHECK among them:** [n]

## Steps to the goal

| Done | # | Step | Command | Required | Status | Produces | Your time |
|------|---|------|---------|----------|--------|----------|-----------|
| [ ] | 1 | | | | | | |

`Required` is the catalog's word for the tier. `Your time` is yours to fill; the
plan does not guess durations.

## Repeats

Steps that run once per system, story or similar, with the count the files show.

| Step | Repeats per | Counted | Not yet done |
|------|-------------|---------|--------------|

## Decision points

Phase gates on the way (`/gate-check`). Verdicts are advisory; you decide whether
to go on.

## Skipped on this plan

Steps in the catalog that this plan does not include, each with the reason.
A step left off the plan is named here, never dropped silently.

| Step | Why it is not on the plan |
|------|---------------------------|

## Not detectable from files (NO_CHECK)

Steps whose completion the plan cannot see. Tick them by hand above.
